The results could point toward a long-awaited treatment for one of PTSD’s most distressing and stubborn symptoms.

articles.title: Dirty air may trigger painful rheumatoid arthritis flares
articles.summary: Tiny pollution particles from smoke, soot, and dust may worsen rheumatoid arthritis and raise the risk of painful flares, particularly after prolonged exposure. The findings suggest that avoiding poor air quality could become an important part of managing the disease.
